title: Making a Smooth Exit? Menthol Bans and Cigarette Sales in Massachusetts
authors: Ali Goli; Simha Mummalaneni; Pradeep K. Chintagunta
eligible_reason: Single-date design. The Massachusetts statewide menthol ban takes effect June 1, 2020 for every treated store: treatment_dummy = treatment_group x (week_end > 2020-06-01), with control geographies outside New England/NY. felm(log(packs+1) ~ treatment_dummy + treatment_group + time_dummy + price.idx | geog + week_end | 0 | geog) on geography-menthol-week aggregates; every column includes the time-varying price index control. Structural nested-logit demand model and counterfactuals follow. No staggered adoption.
design_notes: R + Python (TensorFlow). replication_code/2.Regs_summaryStat.R (DiD tables), 1.Figures.R (event-study style figures from DiD_data.RDS), 3.nestedLogitLL_RC_nested_const.py (structural model), 4.counterfactualLogit_RC_nested.R.
data_provenance_note: ReadMe: 'The data sets under the data folder are synthetic and bear no relationship to the original NielsenIQ data.'
software_notes: R for reduced form, Python for the structural model.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). One statewide date; synthetic data; price-index control in every column.
